description: This source file contains a static class 'Converter' that provides utility functions to convert charting objects (like fonts, pens, brushes) into PdfSharp.Drawing objects, facilitating rendering of charts in PDF documents.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: A static utility class for converting charting DOM objects into PdfSharp drawing objects (fonts, pens, brushes).

methods.name: ToXFont
methods.description: Converts a custom Font object into an XFont, using default font attributes when necessary.

methods.name: ToXPen (overload 1)
methods.description: Creates an XPen from a LineFormat object, with fallback to default pen properties.

methods.name: ToXPen (overload 2)
methods.description: Creates an XPen from a LineFormat object, specifying default color, width, and dash style.

methods.name: ToXBrush (fillFormat)
methods.description: Creates an XBrush from a FillFormat object, with fallback to default color.

methods.name: ToXBrush (font)
methods.description: Creates an XBrush from a Font object, with fallback to default color.
